+import os
+
+import boto3
+
+from security_models import encode_blob, normalize_payload, response_dict
+
+
+def envelope_encrypt(payload, config=None):
+    payload = normalize_payload(payload)
+    config = config or {}
+    region = config.get("region") or os.getenv("AWS_REGION")
+    kms = boto3.client("kms", region_name=region)
+    data_key = kms.generate_data_key(KeyId=config["key_id"], KeySpec="AES_256")
+    plaintext = payload["plaintext"]
+    if isinstance(plaintext, str):
+        plaintext = plaintext.encode("utf-8")
+    data_key_plaintext = data_key["Plaintext"]
+    ciphertext = bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(plaintext, data_key_plaintext * (len(plaintext) // len(data_key_plaintext) + 1)))
+    return response_dict(
+        encrypted_data_key=encode_blob(data_key["CiphertextBlob"]),
+        ciphertext=encode_blob(ciphertext),
+    )
+
*** Add File: sign_or_verify_key.py
+import boto3
+
+from security_models import decode_blob, normalize_payload
+
+
+def sign_or_verify_key(payload, config=None):
+    payload = normalize_payload(payload)
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("kms", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    if payload.get("signature"):
+        response = client.verify(
+            KeyId=config.get("signing_key_id") or config["key_id"],
+            Message=payload["message"],
+            MessageType="RAW",
+            Signature=decode_blob(payload["signature"]),
+            SigningAlgorithm=payload.get("signing_algorithm", "RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256"),
+        )
+        return {"verified": response["SignatureValid"]}
+    response = client.sign(
+        KeyId=config.get("signing_key_id") or config["key_id"],
+        Message=payload["message"],
+        MessageType="RAW",
+        SigningAlgorithm=payload.get("signing_algorithm", "RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256"),
+    )
+    return {"signature": response["Signature"]}

+import os
+
+import boto3
+
+from security_models import encode_blob, normalize_payload, response_dict
+
+
+def envelope_encrypt(payload, config=None):
+    payload = normalize_payload(payload)
+    config = config or {}
+    region = config.get("region") or os.getenv("AWS_REGION")
+    kms = boto3.client("kms", region_name=region)
+    data_key = kms.generate_data_key(KeyId=config["key_id"], KeySpec="AES_256")
+    plaintext = payload["plaintext"]
+    if isinstance(plaintext, str):
+        plaintext = plaintext.encode("utf-8")
+    data_key_plaintext = data_key["Plaintext"]
+    ciphertext = bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(plaintext, data_key_plaintext * (len(plaintext) // len(data_key_plaintext) + 1)))
+    return response_dict(
+        encrypted_data_key=encode_blob(data_key["CiphertextBlob"]),
+        ciphertext=encode_blob(ciphertext),
+    )

+import boto3
+
+from security_models import decode_blob, normalize_payload
+
+
+def sign_or_verify_key(payload, config=None):
+    payload = normalize_payload(payload)
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("kms", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    if payload.get("signature"):
+        response = client.verify(
+            KeyId=config.get("signing_key_id") or config["key_id"],
+            Message=payload["message"],
+            MessageType="RAW",
+            Signature=decode_blob(payload["signature"]),
+            SigningAlgorithm=payload.get("signing_algorithm", "RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256"),
+        )
+        return {"verified": response["SignatureValid"]}
+    response = client.sign(
+        KeyId=config.get("signing_key_id") or config["key_id"],
+        Message=payload["message"],
+        MessageType="RAW",
+        SigningAlgorithm=payload.get("signing_algorithm", "RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256"),
+    )
+    return {"signature": response["Signature"]}

+import boto3
+
+from security_models import normalize_payload
+
+
+def payload_safety(payload, config=None):
+    payload = normalize_payload(payload)
+    comprehend = boto3.client("comprehend", region_name=(config or {}).get("region"))
+    text = payload.get("plaintext", "")
+    response = comprehend.detect_sentiment(Text=text, LanguageCode=payload.get("language", "en"))
+    return {"unsafe": response.get("Sentiment") in {"NEGATIVE", "MIXED"}, "sentiment": response.get("Sentiment")}

+import boto3
+
+
+def crypto_audit_embedding(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    body = {"inputText": payload["text"]}
+    response = client.invoke_model(modelId="amazon.titan-embed-text-v1", body=str(body).encode("utf-8"))
+    return {"embedding": response["body"].read()}
